title: Every save overwrites the whole notes list from this tab's stale memory, so a second tab's notes are deleted
evidence: Driven with Playwright in one browser context. app.js loads `notes` once at line 17-18 and `commit()` writes the entire array through store.js `saveNotes`. There is no `storage` event listener and no re-read before the write.
failing_case: Open the page in tab A, create 'A-note'. Open tab B, create 'B-note'. localStorage now holds ['A-note','B-note']. Type in the body of A-note in tab A and wait 500 ms. localStorage holds only ['A-note']: B-note is gone with no message, and tab A shows 'Saved'.
remediation: Before each write, re-read the stored list and merge by id and `updated` (or write one key per note). Listen for the `storage` event and reload or merge into `notes`. Show a conflict message when the stored version changed.

title: A failed backup write is swallowed, yet the load message says the data 'was kept', and the next save destroys it
evidence: `backupRaw` ignores the result. The three callers (store.js lines 47, 52, 66) then return a problem string that states the data was kept under 'notes-backup'. Driven: with 3 MB of unreadable data in 'notes' (quota about 5M chars), the backup is empty ('backup len: 0'), but the status still says 'The unreadable data was kept under "notes-backup"'. Clicking New note then replaced 'notes' (length 122) and the original is gone.
failing_case: Stored value in 'notes' is a 3 MB blob in an unknown or newer shape. Reload: the page claims the data was backed up, the backup setItem throws QuotaExceededError and is ignored. The user clicks New note: `saveNotes` overwrites 'notes' with a 122-character document. The 3 MB is unrecoverable and the user was told it was kept.
remediation: Make `backupRaw` return success. If it fails, do not claim the data was kept; say so, and refuse to overwrite STORAGE_KEY until the user exports or confirms (for example, put the app in read-only mode).

title: Every renderList rebuilds all buttons, so keyboard focus is dropped to the page top after choosing a note, deleting one, or an autosave tick
evidence: renderList (app.js:59-90) always replaces every <li>. It is called from selectNote (app.js:100), deleteNote (app.js:121), flushSave (app.js:49) and the search handler. Nothing restores focus afterwards. WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order (A). Traced; not driven because no shell was available.
failing_case: Keyboard user tabs to a note in the list and presses Enter: selectNote -> renderList removes the focused button, document.activeElement becomes body, and the next Tab starts again at the skip-less top (search box). Same after Delete on a note, and when the 500 ms autosave fires while a list button has focus. Screen reader users lose their place each time.
remediation: Update list items in place (key by id) or, after replaceChildren, refocus the button with the same data-id; after a delete, focus the next item or the New note button. Move focus to the title field on select if that is the intended flow.

title: With a search term active, New note opens an editor for a note that is not in the list
evidence: Driven: search 'zzz', click New note. Result: list has 0 items, the empty text reads 'No notes match "zzz".', and the editor holds the new 'Untitled' note. `renderList` (line 62) filters by title, so the new note is hidden. The same happens when an edit changes a title so it no longer matches.
failing_case: Type 'zzz' in Search notes, click New note, type a title. The user sees 'No notes match', with no row for what they are editing, so they cannot tell it was saved or find it to delete it.
remediation: Clear the search field (and the shared search) in `createNote` before selecting the new note, and always render the selected note in the list.

title: Every term typed into the private notes search is also sent to the server in a URL, with no notice
evidence: The one `search` input drives both `renderList` and `searchShared` (line 170-173). Notes are otherwise local-only (localStorage). Driven: typing 'zzz' produced GET /api/shared?q=zzz on the server. On a static host the answer is 404 and every search shows 'Shared notes could not be loaded (server answered 404)...'.
failing_case: A user searches their own notes for a private term such as a diagnosis or password hint. After 250 ms the term is in the server's access log as a query string. Nothing on the page says the search leaves the browser.
remediation: Make shared search a separate, labelled control or an explicit opt-in. Send the term in a POST body and say in the label that it is sent to the server.

title: 'Search notes' matches titles only, so text inside a note is never found
evidence: app.js:62 filters on n.title alone; index.html:14 labels the field 'Search notes'; empty result copy at app.js:87 says 'No notes match'. Traced.
failing_case: A note titled 'Untitled' has body 'milk, eggs'. Searching 'milk' shows 'No notes match "milk"' although a note contains it.

requirement.why: The field is labelled 'Search notes', not 'Search titles'.

remediation: Match body as well, or relabel the field 'Search titles'.
